availableModes.label: Default Permissions
availableModes.description: Edit files and run commands with Codex's default approval flow.

availableModes.label: Auto-review
availableModes.description: Same workspace-write permissions as Default, but eligible `on-request` approvals are routed through the auto-reviewer subagent.

availableModes.label: Full Access
availableModes.description: Edit files, run commands, and access the network without additional prompts.

guidance: You will get notified when the created agent finishes, errors, or needs permission. Do not poll for status; continue with other work until the notification arrives.
